Strategy & Business Operations Manager
Razorpay
Bengaluru, Karnataka, India (Hybrid)

About Razorpay:
Razorpay is India's premier payments and financial infrastructure company for businesses.

Responsibilities:
• Drive corporate strategy, GTM expansion, and market sizing for new fintech verticals.
• Model unit economics, pricing structures, and financial projections for board reviews.
• Collaborate with product management and enterprise sales to accelerate product adoption.

Requirements:
• 4 to 6 years of experience in management consulting, corporate strategy, or bizops.
• MBA is preferred (top-tier B-schools).
• High analytical rigor, executive presentation skills, and deep financial modeling mastery.
